claims: As of March 20, 2026, average mortgage rates have hovered in the low-to-mid 6% range.
As of March 20, 2026, the 30-year fixed rate was widely reported around 6.32% to 6.37%.
As of March 20, 2026, mortgage rates have seen a slight increase over the past week.
As of March 20, 2026, 15-year fixed loans averaged around 5.64%–5.67%.
As of March 20, 2026, 5/1 ARMs averaged around 5.49%.
National average 30-Year Fixed mortgage rate was ~6.32% – 6.37% for March 19-20, 2026.
National average 15-Year Fixed mortgage rate was ~5.64% – 5.67% for March 19-20, 2026.
National average 5/1 ARM mortgage rate was ~5.49% for March 19-20, 2026.
National average FHA 30-Year mortgage rate was ~5.91% – 6.50% for March 19-20, 2026.
Average 30-year refinance rates were around 6.37% on March 19, 2026.
Mortgage rates moved up recently, reaching their highest point in over three months due to shifts in financial market expectations as of March 20, 2026.
